_meta.purpose: Every user-facing UI string in the app (buttons, labels, titles, instructions, error/status messages), pulled out of the source code into one editable file. This is a translation-READY export, not a wired-up translation - the app still reads these strings from the source files, not from this file. Wiring a real i18n library is separate follow-up work.
_meta.howToEdit: Edit the text on the right-hand side of each ": " pair freely. Do NOT change the keys (the short names on the left, like "title" or "confirmButton") - engineering matches strings back to the app by key.
_meta.placeholders: Anything written as {{likeThis}} is filled in by the app at runtime (a name, a number, a count) - keep the {{...}} token exactly as written, in whatever position makes sense in the translated sentence.
_meta.pluralization: A few strings have separate Singular/Plural variants (e.g. subtitleSingular / subtitlePlural) because English changes the sentence depending on a count. Translate each variant to whatever your language's equivalent grammatical form is.
_meta.arrays: Some entries are numbered lists (point1/point2/point3, or step1/step2/step3, or a list of Q&A pairs) - these render in that exact order on screen. Translate the text; don't reorder, add, or remove entries without checking with engineering first.
_meta.excluded: Two things were deliberately left out of this file: (1) the interview question text and talking points shown during recording - those already live in the database in English/Hindi/Marathi and are managed separately, not in app code; (2) developer-only debug UI (a theme switcher and a dev navigation menu) that real distributors never see, plus a handful of placeholder/mock values standing in for data that will come from the backend later (e.g. a sample phone number, a sample distributor ID) - those aren't translatable copy, they're temporary test data.
_meta.notesOnProperNouns: A few entries are names/brand names used in mocked-up screens (e.g. "Vardaan Paints", "Rajesh") rather than general copy - usually fine to leave as-is or transliterate, not translate.
_meta.languageNames: The languageNames block is a special case: each language's name for ITSELF (an endonym). Keep identical across strings.en/hi/mr.json - same convention every app's language picker uses (a Hindi speaker looking for Hindi in an English-language picker still needs to see "हिन्दी", not a translated word for it). Do not translate these three values differently per file.

onboarding.step1Body: Answer a few short questions on camera, one at a time. The app helps you get in position before recording.
onboarding.step2Body: Your answers help your company understand what is working and what can improve. Share honest examples from your day-to-day work.
onboarding.step3Body: Find a quiet spot, face the light and steady your phone. Listen to each question, record your answer, then review your takes before choosing to send.
onboarding.languageBody: Choose the language you are most comfortable with. You can change it later in Profile.

consent.title: Please read this — it's important
consent.point1: Record answers to your campaign questions, review your takes and choose what to send.
consent.point2: Review your takes before sending. Selected videos and audio go to Zeist, your campaign organization and AWS storage.
consent.point3: ElevenLabs transcribes your audio; Google Gemini analyzes transcript text. Framing guidance stays on your device.
consent.checkboxLabel: I am 18+ and accept the Terms of Use and Privacy Policy.
consent.hint: Select both boxes to continue. You can choose not to record or send.

questionBrief.prepPoint1: Face a window or a light, and keep your phone steady.
questionBrief.prepPoint2: Find a quiet spot where you can speak comfortably.

questionBrief.beforeYouStartBody: Face a window or lamp, find a quiet moment, and keep your answer to about 45-60 seconds - enough to say something real, short enough to hold attention.
questionBrief.nervousBody: Talk to the camera like a friend, not an audience. Take a breath before you start. If you stumble, just keep going - the natural version is the good one.

deletion.title: Delete account
deletion.warning: This permanently deletes your account, submitted recordings, transcripts and analysis from our active systems. Your recordings and personal prompts on this device will also be removed. This cannot be undone.
deletion.timing: Access stops when your request is accepted. Cloud cleanup runs in the background and may take longer if an upload or processing job is still running. Backups and external providers follow the retention arrangements in the Privacy Policy.
deletion.acknowledge: I understand that my account and recordings will be deleted permanently.
deletion.wrongPassword: That password is incorrect. Please try again.
deletion.unavailable: Account deletion is not available on this server yet. No deletion was requested.
deletion.requestError: We could not confirm the request. Please check your connection and try again.
deletion.recoveryBody: We will verify any interrupted request before opening the app. Accepted requests cannot be cancelled. If device cleanup fails, your account stays inaccessible here while you retry.
deletion.recoveryError: Could not finish checking or cleaning this account. Please retry when connected.
deletion.acceptedNotice: Your deletion request was accepted and you are signed out. Cloud cleanup will continue in the background.
deletion.accountChanged: The signed-in account changed. No deletion was sent for the other account.
deletion.recoverySignInBody: Retry the status check, or sign in to the same account if your login expired. Another account cannot resolve this request. Using another account preserves this account’s drafts and pending recovery.
